title: A cooling or unfunded model must answer a retryable 429, never 400
goal: Observed in a live engine mission: after SiliconFlow was rate-limited and escalation picked claude-sonnet (whose provider has no credit), the gateway answered HTTP 400 on turn 1 of every later attempt, and the adapter could only report 'gateway answered HTTP 400 on turn 1'. A model that cannot serve right now is a temporary condition, not a malformed request: it must answer 429 with a Retry-After carrying the cooldown, so the caller backs off or escalates and the reason survives into the failure record. 400 is reserved for a request the gateway cannot parse.
